# Discussion questions

- What are the limitations of these sytems given their training data? i.e. is the information needed actually in the training data? (in relation to linguistics: information that is not about high-resource languages)
- from LD: What is the point of citation, practically as well as ethically? (consider sharing some of the following embedded links in preparation for this discussion). How does a collaboratively built resource such as Wikipedia, or a peer-reviewed academic resource, differ from generative AI tools such as ChatGPT or Perplexity AI (both of which are being sued by creative workers and publications including the New York Times for violation of copyright). Consider sharing this thinkpiece on search interfaces by Leslie Allison and Tiffany DeRewal to help students to think about “friction” in this context
